description.value:
Creeps and Curses V.3.1

Special Trait. Please note that these abilities are incredibly powerful even for the JJK system and should only be used for purposely high power games. Of course, certain traits are stronger than others. Stages of these traits have been added to grow with characters with higher levels of play. Dormant, Stirring, and Awakened. Though a DM can decide to change the leveling format or instead give them out at appropriate character moments.

Extra Limbs. You can use the additional limbs and mouths on your body to make handsigns and chant to activate techniques faster than any normal sorcerer. The action cost of a technique is decreased by one level for you (Full Turn Action > Action > Bonus Action > Reaction) and can ignore a limitation for Chanting. Additionally, when you take the Attack action on your turn, you can make an additional melee attack as part of that attack action.

Powerful Body. You are one size larger to accommodate the additions to your body, your hit point maximum increases by 2 times your level and you gain an additional 2 hit points every time you gain a level (This replaces Strong Body). Additionally, your Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution scores increase by 4 and so does their maximum.

Natural Weapons. The damage of your unarmed strikes increases to 1d12. When you make an unarmed strike as part of the Attack action, you can attempt to grapple as a bonus action.

Special Trait tiers stack: keep the earlier tiers on the sheet. When a benefit says it replaces an earlier one, the module's effects already account for it.

system.requirements: Must not be a Cursed Corpse; Perfect Form, level 6
